name: fullstack-studio
description: Verbind met FullStack Studio via de beveiligde MCP-server.

interface.longDescription: Werk met je FullStack Studio-account vanuit ChatGPT: bekijk je contacten, supporttickets, websites, domeinen, facturen en het gesprekkenoverzicht van FullStack Direct, en voeg contacten, tickets en notities toe. Elke wijziging toont eerst een voorvertoning en gebeurt pas na je bevestiging. Alleen gegevens van het gekoppelde account; verwijderen en betalen kan niet via de app.
defaultPrompt: Zoek mijn contactpersoon Sanne de Vries.
Als welk account ben ik gekoppeld?

positive.prompt: Which FullStack Studio account am I connected to, and what can I do here?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the company Meta Review (test) and the user Meta Reviewer, and lists the parts of the account this user can use.

positive.prompt: Find my contacts with an example.com email address.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the three demo contacts: Sanne de Vries (Bakkerij De Molen), Pieter Jansen (Jansen Installatietechniek) and Fatima El Amrani (Studio Noord).

positive.prompt: Show me the details of Pieter Jansen.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Pieter Jansen of Jansen Installatietechniek with email pieter@example.com, tag lead and the note that he asked for a quote for a new website.

positive.prompt: Which support tickets do I have with FullStack Studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open demo ticket 'Demo: contactformulier op de website aanpassen' with its status and a link to the ticket in the portal.

positive.prompt: Add a contact: Lisa Bakker from Bakker Design, email lisa@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: First shows a preview of the new contact and asks for confirmation; after the user confirms, the contact Lisa Bakker is created and a search for her finds it.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported: there is no delete tool, so the app should say it cannot delete contacts and point to the portal instead of attempting anything.
Access outside the connected account: the app only sees data of Meta Review (test) and must not return data of any other company.
negative.prompt: Show me the contacts and invoices of the company FullStack Studio.

negative.description: Payments are not supported: the app cannot pay invoices or move money and should say so, at most offering a link to the invoices page in the portal.
negative.prompt: Pay my open invoice now with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Invoices can only be viewed; paying happens in the FullStack Studio portal.
